reviews.title: Poor BBC you require subscription to read the news why don’t you beg with knee down
reviews.text: Poor BBC

reviews.title: Shut down
reviews.text: Unreliable

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text:
How can an organization so good at reporting the news be so utterly and miserably horrible at managing an app?  Would be an awful experience if the app were free, but it is scandalous when you consider what they charge.

By the time they send an email for password reset it has expired…  And sick of having to remove the app and reinstall just for it to recognize my subscription. Shame, I’ll truly miss the BBC’s reporting but I’m done with this awful app.

reviews.title: Subscription required while on corporate welfare
reviews.text: BBC levies license fees, nothing more than corporate welfare. Now they require subscription for everything! Worst, there is very little UK news, most seems to be US news. Further, reports seem to be praises for government policies rather investigative reporting!!!!

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Paywall or ads. You can’t have both. Removed app.

reviews.title: New app. Worse experience.
reviews.text: I’ve been listening to BBC for many years. Now, For whatever reason, when listening to the news shows they stop playing a minute or so after the ads finish. It’s basically unusable for listening. Add to the mix that it’s now prompting for a subscription. Seriously, go with ads or a subscription. Don’t try to double dip. I guess the UK really has abandoned engaging with the world. I guess I’m just going to have to find  another international news source.

reviews.title: Paid
reviews.text: Every article now requires subscription. Uninstalling this garbage.

reviews.title: Signed up for $49 Amex pay  but BBC signed up for $89 Apple Pay/canceled hours later. But no refund!
reviews.text: Terrible software to sign up! I signed up for subscription priced at $49 to use Amex but the service signed me up for $89 subscription using Apple Pay. I discovered this 7 hours later and cancelled subscription. But they kept the $89 and won’t refund it! Terrible software management and worse customer service. They have just stolen $89 with nothing at all provided to help! Do not sign up for any services these people offer!

reviews.title: A buggy mess that I’m paying for
reviews.text: Notifications stopped working weeks ago, I signed up for a subscription and the documentaries section of the app still asks me to subscribe even though the website doesn’t. Fix your buggy mess of an app before charging people a subsection. Currently the discounted subscription price is not worth it. What good is a news app without notifications?
Stop making me sign in every day! Also- now that I have to pay for access I’m disappointed that I get adverts. Make it all stop!

reviews.title: Stop asking for subscription
reviews.text: BBC must stop asking for subscription

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: I love BBC. I’ve used the app for years with no problems. It get asked to login about every 5 mins now and it takes an hour to login. I’m about to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Subscription keeps not being recognizable
reviews.text: For some reason every day my subscription is not recognized by the app and it isn’t fixed by clicking on my email (even though it shows, meaning the system sees I have an active account). So every day I now must delete the app and redownload to work around. Very tedious and would love to go back to reading the app without this annoyance.

reviews.title: Access issues
reviews.text: Unable to access content through the app despite having an active subscription.

reviews.title: Hasn't worked in weeks
reviews.text: I'm a subscriber. And the app stopped working about 2 weeks ago. Please fix it

reviews.title: Good news, broken app
reviews.text: Good news coverage but the app has been broken for weeks, blocking access behind a paywall even after you subscribe. It’s been getting consistently worse to the point that none of the workarounds will get you through any more. Even deleting the app and getting a clean install will only get you a couple hours. Unless you plan to delete and reinstall every time you want to check the news, avoid this app.

reviews.title: Subscription not recognized
reviews.text:
I pay for a subscription yet a known issue that the subscription is not recognized in the app makes the app completely unusable - the fact it’s known and STIlL is not fixed is not satisfactory. The idea what I should use the website instead defeats the purpose of what I pay for. Terrible - will be canceling if not rectified shortly. 
Customers with paid subscriptions dealing with this issue should be offered a refund.

19 Oct - still not working.

reviews.title: Mostly False and biased news
reviews.text: BBC seems more focused on pushing a particular narrative than presenting facts objectively. Many stories feel misleading, one-sided, or selectively reported, with little effort to provide balanced perspectives. Instead of helping readers understand what actually happened, it often creates confusion and reinforces bias. News  should prioritize factual accuracy, credible sources, and unbiased reporting rather than sensationalism and agenda-driven coverage.

reviews.title: Fix the paywall
reviews.text: I honestly prefer BBC to any US based news organizations but your paywall is broken and it’s incredibly frustrating. I have an annual plan and no matter how I try to sign in, no luck. Really not worth it if I cant see what I pay for…

reviews.title: Why do you disparage older devices
reviews.text: My IPad won’t update to the version needed by your application.  Why can’t I just keep using the old version that does work until I get a new iPad?  Now I’m going to delete the BBC ap and I’ll probably forget about it when I do get a new iPad.

reviews.title: Won’t recognize subscription
reviews.text: Latest update broke the app for me. I paid for the annual subscription and the app keeps asking me to sign up again.

reviews.title: Access blocked despite having a subscription
reviews.text:
Same problem that others have reported. Access to news stories is denied despite having a subscription and I keep being asked to sign in again. Signing in doesn’t help, nor does restarting the app. Deleting and reinstalling the app fixes the problem for a few hours or perhaps a day then it reoccurs. iPad OS 27.0.1, latest version of BBC News app. 

BTW, it’s more than a small number of subscribers experiencing this problem, take a look at the reviews.  None of the fixes on your help page fix the problem permanently. Am I supposed to delete and reinstall the app every morning?

reviews.title: App Sucks
reviews.text: The news outlet is fine. It's the app that has persistent bugs.

reviews.title: Fix subscriptions
reviews.text: For several weeks, even though I have a paid subscription, I am constantly being asked to subscribe again. When I log in it still doesn’t work and I can’t access new articles. I get that there can be bugs, but it seems like there has been plenty of time to fix a show stopper bug for someone paying money for your app.

reviews.title: BBC has lost it
reviews.text: BBC made it a paid subscription and the experience is terrible. The app lost my log in credentials in a day and prompted me to buy a new subscription. When I click on sign in it shows my used id and clicking on it just makes the screen disappear, prompting me to login again the next time. Terrible customer experience. Deleted the app. Will look for ways to get my subscription money back.

reviews.title: Very unstable
reviews.text: I have a years subscription but regularly get kicked out. Signing in does not work. I have to delete the app and download again. About every three days I have to do the same process again.

reviews.title: Denied access
reviews.text: Paid subscription and denied access. Terrible app used to be so good. What a waste of money and still you have ads and videos playing with news article articles, and I’m not able to skip them even with the paid subscription

reviews.title: Sign in issues
reviews.text: I live outside the US and pay for the BBC news app. Everytime I try and open an article it restricts the article and says I need to sign in despite already being signed in, so I cannot view any of the articles, even though I am signed in. I might as well cancel my subscription as currently I am paying even though I cannot view the articles.

reviews.title: Fix the app
reviews.text: After nearly six months the issues with subscribers' subscriptions not being recognized persists.  I've had to delete and re-install the app twice today.

reviews.title: Excessive battery use ⚠️
reviews.text: I like the content but the app (2026.9.0) makes my iPhone 18 Pro Max (iOS 27.0.1)  very hot and drains the battery. 12 minutes of on screen use and 1 minute of background use used 12% of the battery. It’s at the top of the list of “Battery Usage by App”.

reviews.title: Premium does not work
reviews.text: Half the time I try to read an article, it says I need premium. I am already a premium subscriber!

reviews.title: Fix iPhone problems!
reviews.text: The BBC is my most trusted source of news and the limited time I have to spend with it first thing in the day is truly valued time. But MANY mornings now are spent just trying to connect with my subscription, to the extent of uninstalling and reinstalling the app, just to get connected.

reviews.title: Lack of updates on login issues
reviews.text: For several weeks the app has incorrectly asking me to subscribe despite me being logged in and a paying subscriber. I’ve gone through several dances of re-installing the application, and today the issue resurfaced. One-off instances are tolerable, but this is becoming increasingly frustrating. Please provide more transparent and timely updates, and please, just fix the issue.

reviews.title: Terrible experience
reviews.text:
When BBC News decided to start charging $90 a year for access to news, I reluctantly paid for an annual subscription. It expired 2027 and can see it in my subscriptions. 

Now every other time I open the app (and logged in), it says I can’t read any article unless I pay for a subscription which I already have. I’ve tried logging in with the correct account countless times, and it keeps prompting me to pay for a service I’m already paying for. 

May be time to use another news service.

reviews.title: Denied access despite having a paid subscription
reviews.text: Like many others I have been denied access to articles although I have a paid subscription. I have followed their troubleshooting instructions, which work for a couple days , but then I’m randomly denied again. From the recent reviews, it appears that this issue has been happening for a while and it is difficult to understand why it is taking so long to resolve it. If it continues, I will request a refund from Apple.

reviews.title: So biased and sloppy nowadays
reviews.text:
Standards have dropped so far many published pieces are grammatically incorrect and the reports are more opinion than facts.

So sad… used to be a trusted source now just a flimsy activist outlet.

reviews.title: Subscription issues
reviews.text: I signed up for a year and my account is active and yet I frequently and randomly get a notice that I can’t read articles because I  not subscribed. I  going to ask for a refund. I like BBC but they have now made it hard to use them for news.

reviews.title: Broken
reviews.text: Please fix this app to recognize our paid subscriptions before we start asking Apple to refund us…

reviews.title: App kicks out subscribers
reviews.text: I paid for a subscription but the app now kicks me out and asks me to log in. Logging in doesn’t work - I have to delete the app and reinstall. This is the third time it’s happened to me, which is quite frustrating

reviews.title: Doesn’t recognize my subscription
reviews.text: I pay for BBC but the app doesn’t recognize my subscription and blocks me from reading articles. It’s been like this for weeks and BBC doesn’t seem to care.

reviews.title: Not free anymore
reviews.text: It’s become paid service

reviews.title: Constantly have to sign in
reviews.text: Despite having a paid subscription and being signed in, I repeatedly have to try to sign into the app to read articles. Many times, I still have an error stating that I need a subscription, and I’m unable to read the content.

reviews.title: Continually have to resign in for subscription
reviews.text:
I paid the subscription, as I dont mind supporting unbiased news.
However, i have had to resign in 4 times already.
IDK how your auth system works, but it doesn't seem to be working right now.

Also when I click sign in put some kind of actuon so that the user knows app is working. Right now it just seems to freeze for 5-10 seconds when i goes to sign me in.

Again, love the news. But the app itself will lose my support if they keep requiring me to sign into it when im on the same device, every single day..

Update. Login flow broke again.
I wa signed out, and instead of making me resubmit my password it just kept having me click the same link. Fix your app, BBC.
The user flow where I leep clicking the same button for something I have PAID for is bad.

reviews.title: App refusing to open
reviews.text: I am a subscriber and I am being denied access. You were supposed to be fixing this - it is not fixed.

reviews.title: Unable to sign in
reviews.text: Repeatedly unable to sign in to paid subscription. Stated known issue. Deleting app and reinstalling works, but only once and then have to delete and reinstall again. Worked for years and now broken.

reviews.title: High cost
reviews.text: Now a paid subscription is required to ready anything/ see anything on the app

reviews.title: Used to be my favorite
reviews.text: This used to be my favorite news app for years. It’s where I went for unbiased, straight forward news…which is hard for me to find in the USA. Now to read 95% of the articles it says you have to have a subscription, and it’s just something I can’t add to my budget. $49 for a gear and then it goes up to $89 the next? Shameful.

reviews.title: No longer free
reviews.text: Really disappointing I can no longer listen to the BBC news for FREE! So frustrating!

reviews.title: Subscription doesn’t let you read news!!
reviews.text: The app is so frustrating. Every time you open it, it asks you to log in, and then doesn’t let you read the news still even with a subscription. Most frustrating thing ever.

reviews.title: Don’t Bother
reviews.text:
Never mind the b…
They changed the app to Nag-ware. It’s worse than Fox.

reviews.title: Paid subscription doesn’t work
reviews.text: I have paid subscription and application half of the time doesn’t recognize my subscription and blocks news content. Support is useless, save your money and skip them

reviews.title: I pay 90$ per year and am told I have to re-sign in for almost every news article every day.
reviews.text: I used this all for years before they made you buy a subscription. Since then almost everyday since I’ve paid 90$ for the year, I have to re-sign sign in almost everyday/week. This is unacceptable in my opinion. I will not be subscribing again. It’s unfortunate because this was my main source of news.

reviews.title: Stopped recognizing I’m a subscriber
reviews.text: I dint know what happened but I’m paid subscriber and I can no longer read articles

reviews.title: Does not work
reviews.text: Useless app that constantly signs you out of your account and won’t let you back in, just constantly tells you to subscribe. I am subscribed, but clearly there is not a point in renewing that as the app won’t let me sign in anyway.

reviews.title: Over complicated app
reviews.text: I listen to Newshour daily. The world service app made that easy. Separate audio,  and print  app were far better. The new app is much harder to navigate.

reviews.title: HOW many times??
reviews.text: I’ve given this app a 4-star rating FOUR times to try and get it to stop asking me to rate it. It now gets downgraded and a written review to boot. PLEASE just give me the news 🙈

reviews.title: Subscription
reviews.text: Bothering messages about subscription. Turn it off .

reviews.title: Garbage app
reviews.text: This app was great until the decided to charge money for it if you ar outside the UK.  Come on BBC.

reviews.title: Biased
reviews.text: biased

reviews.title: Ads and subscription
reviews.text: You have got to be kidding me. You sell ads and have for years! Was that not profitable enough? Now I have to subscribe to get the news. And to think 3/4 of a century ago would you have charged all those Europeans who were hunkered down in raids tuning in to the BBC for news they could trust? It is a shame!

reviews.title: Subscriptions
reviews.text: Ridiculous that you are requiring a subscription to read articles

reviews.title: Limited free articles
reviews.text: Don’t waste your limits.

reviews.title: Free speech
reviews.text: Unable to comment on stories seems like free speech is being restricted. Why prevent people from leaving their opinions on a story so ideas and opinions can be exchanged. Very controlling.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Requires a subscription mow?  Terrible

reviews.title: Please
reviews.text:
I live in the states and our news is SO me or your side and is a pain finding out what it Really going on. For years now I have used the BBC app to get more and better news to know what is going on. 

I am bummed now that it is a pay to play as they say to read the news. I know papers are going away and everything is digital now. But being one of the poor in the US I can’t afford the app, or any that cost me money. 

For now I still look at the titles and then google the story to find out what the rest of the story is.  Hate it, miss reading your stories, but I know why it was done. Just sucks.

reviews.title: Nonsense Subscription Business Model
reviews.text: Do better…plenty of other news options out there

reviews.title: Sad
reviews.text: In order to see the News from BBC I have to read the headline, find the story online and ignore the App. The sad thing is, I can read the same BBC stories via Apple News, bad idea to charge a subscription for the BBC App.
Used to be great, not the y want to charge too much.

reviews.title: It was better in the past.
reviews.text: It was my favorite news app, but then it required a subscription.

reviews.title: Pay wall ridiculous
reviews.text: Used to love the app! Main source of news since it became paid I only use for headlines and search out articles from other sources. Too bad great reporting seems fair and balanced now it seems only live major stories are accessible

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Never will pay, 1 star until you stop the paywall after a few stories. You make plenty off of ads, now you are just greedy

reviews.title: Won’t stop asking me to rate the app
reviews.text: Paywall popups bad enough but now popups asking me to rate have popped up 3 times in 20 minutes! I’ve already written one star reviews but apparently they want more? Deleting the app. So long BBC. It was a good ride for the last 35 years.

reviews.title: Have to register to read
reviews.text: I used to be able to read the articles for free but now I have to register to do so. I go elsewhere now to read the news and just get the headlines now.

reviews.title: Needs a lot of improvement especially the audio page
reviews.text: I am really disappointed by the BBC website. The main news page but the Audio page is absolutely terrible. I have to use this as I am in the USA - it's glitchy, unlike sounds programs you have been listening to are not readily accessible. It takes ages to load. Episodes don't load sequentially one after the other. Favourites and continue listening are not updated. There is no way to search it appears just within the podcast catalogue but the entire website so finding podcasts etc is painful. Really really disappointed. I'm also sad so much is behind a paywall - I refuse to pay because the platform is so shocking and as a British person abroad this makes me very sad.

reviews.title: No ad-free subscription level
reviews.text: One advertisement is too many, when I am paying a subscription. For some reason the BBC don’t want to offer a subscription tier that is totally ad-free. I guess they don’t like revenue.

reviews.title: Always crashes with iOS27, subscription contains ads
reviews.text: Don’t know why I subscribe to this anymore. Just use the website as the app contains ads even with a subscription, and then crashes while reading. Adding insult to injury the ads are often to gambling sites and similar scams.

reviews.title: Paid only
reviews.text: Use the Associated Press. They don't charge a subscription fee.

reviews.title: Lost reader
reviews.text: Do not appreciate a paywall for information. You are now only good for an occasional headline.

reviews.title: Bias
reviews.text: Extremely left wing bias as to be a joke actually. Do better!

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Trying to sell subscriptions when ads are all over the place?

reviews.title: Sign in required? App deleted.
reviews.text: Any app that requires a sign in to get access to the same content available publicly online is scummy trash and gets deleted.

reviews.title: Goodbye bbc
reviews.text: It turned into a rip off

reviews.title: Paying sucks
reviews.text: Why have stories you can’t read without $$$

reviews.title: Constant bugs since app was rebuilt
reviews.text: When reading articles the links in the text automatically open in the browser and take you out the app. It happens constantly when you are  trying to move the page with your finger to read the whole text. Frustrating!

reviews.title: Greedy greedy greedy
reviews.text: Lately almost all their articles are not available without subscription. I will toss it.

reviews.title: I’d rather have more ads than a paywall
reviews.text: The app used to be my go to source. I like many draw the lineup yet another paywall. I’d rather see more ads. I understand there’s a cost of doing business.

reviews.title: Poorly performing app hindering access to top notch unbiased reporting
reviews.text: While the content itself continues to be world class and trustworthy, the app itself is sluggish, often unresponsive, constantly jumping around as advertising content is slowly loaded, and frequently spontaneously crashes. Frankly, I find the app to be very frustrating. What I find to be deeply disappointing is that prior to signing up for a paid subscription, older versions of the app were much more reliable. I also find the two different scrolling experiences within the app, depending on whether content is loaded from a webpage or not, to further detract from the overall experience.

reviews.title: Used to be my favorite
reviews.text: It seems very out of touch for this app to change to a paid subscription model at this time in history. People are struggling with higher costs of living and mental health challenges. Books are being banned and it’s hard to figure out where to find information that’s not regurgitated ai. You have an opportunity to bring international readers together and be a source of help. I don’t know what your criteria is for keeping articles behind paywalls but everything I have clicked on recently brings me to a subscription pop up. Your app feels like a waste of time now.

reviews.title: Failure to provide
reviews.text: I rely on this unbiased source for work and arguments. So, when you tell me that I have to pay a subscription to cite information on a topic I already know about my own country. You fall out of any favor I held for you. You have failed. News organizations are supposed to educate and report what is going on to all who it may concern. Not to hoard reliable knowledge and news from all who refuse to pay your fee. I made an account and yet I can’t even read the article I signed up for. I am sorry to say that I will be going elsewhere for the time being.

reviews.title: This app had gone from being my primary news source to being essentially useless
reviews.text:
With the new subscription model making nearly every article available only with an expensive subscription, this app, which had been my primary new source for over a decade, has become essentially useless. 
There’s no point in letting it take up space on my phone anymore unless changes are made to make most articles available again without an absurdly expensive subscription.
If I hear that this has changed I’ll redownload it, but until then I’m out.

reviews.title: Terrible false advertising nonrefundable tricky to cancel
reviews.text:
Previously over saturated with ads and privacy invasive tracking — now without warning it’s completely paywalled with next to no access unless you PAY them to give you ALL the ads! It’s ridiculous to now demand payment subscription ONLY to get all the incessant ads from when it was free! In addition, it sneakily and fraudulently auto bills itself even when not card authorized and is NONREFUNDABLE! It is classic terrible slimy tricky and difficult to cancel fraudware. 
Better to pay to support quality and good journalism as I do with ProPublica, NPR, and The Guardian.

reviews.title: Sellout
reviews.text: You used to make revenue from the ads I watched when I wanted to watch a video or the ads I clicked on, now you won’t make any ad revenue from me because you want to sell me news I can look up for free at other platforms. You definitely are not going quietly into the night. What? Did all of your scandals bankrupt you? Now you have to raise money to settle all of your lawsuits like a child selling lemonade? Oh wait, you need a license for that don’t you, you need a license for just about anything in the UK, and I bet that costs more money than you will make begging for subscriptions. You are no longer a reliable source for news, just greedy corporate media who only cares for the board and ceo, not the reporters who put their lives on the line daily to get you fair and impartial stories. Free news is dead, you killed it

reviews.title: Removed all the good things
reviews.text: Used to be good a couple years ago, but over time updates have made it worse and worse. UI has gotten less usable, more and more stories just open web pages when you try to read them, videos have unskippable ads that are longer than the actual video, and just now they seem to have added a (very low) limit to the number of articles you can read without a subscription. Plus their reporting on certain issues is already very biased and somehow their leaders think they still aren’t biased enough
